top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single prize part on GLP-1 physiology and its active form to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The discovery chain is intact and mature: Holst on incretin physiology, Mojsov on the biologically active peptide, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and the therapeutic rationale. Randomized outcome programmes over more than a decade confirm the benefit. The citation is scoped to discovery of the physiology and active form, so it does not credit drug design. The omission of Knudsen and the unverified priority questions around Mojsov are real costs, but they do not outweigh the achievement, and no award is clearly worse than this proposal.
